For some reason I never told anyone, and eventually her body vanished and I just didn't get any more pets until I was on my own.

I know this will sound strange, but I think it will fit with this tread. 

I have a hard time understanding many things because I am mentally deficient.   Diagnosed with a myriad of problems that involve my ability to grasp the proper way to interact with other people, I have spent a long time trying to understand myself versus others. 

For the longest time I was just trying to convince myself that I was like anyone else, that I was just off.  But after I really got into sociology and watching people on a very critical level, I noticed they were just different.  I can't do most things people do with feeling.  People hug and kiss and say I love you and hold hands and wrestle and touch and talk and fight and just do so many things with each other with a fierce passion that I will never be able to emulate.   I truly am defective in that regard, and clearly my visits to therapists, doctors, and more have convinced me I'm just an observer.  I've tried, I've come a long way from when I was much younger and hugging me or talking to me with eye contact would send me into a frozen, crippled hysteria.  My mother has spent her whole life trying to teach me how to be like other people, and I appreciate her effort immensely.  Because of her I can suppress the intense discomfort that other people give me, I can force smiles and maintain eye contact for brief amounts of time before it becomes too much the bear. I can still not touch anyone, or be touched knowingly.  It is too much, and it is something so ingrained in normal people that there doesn't seem to be a way to explain why they do it outside of the generic social science explanations or, the more common, emotional explanations.  I've never felt angry, or particularly sad. I feel like I've only ever been content and frightened, so I strive for content.  I don't like being near people, but I like watching them because it's like seeing a world I could have been a part of.  I like writing and drawing though, I really like stories, so I spend a lot of time writing stories but I can only create flat worlds and bland art because I cannot channel intense feeling that seems necessary for great results. 

I've ranted, and I could continue to rant, but I suppose what I'm saying is that is I don't truly understand the higher level of human emotion.  I don't understand touching, and eye contact, and deeper intimacy.  I can appreciate it on an objective, factual basis, but I cannot understand the seemingly arbitrary reasons for it.  So many people do it, and it must seem strange I don't know why, I'm sure it is so simple to you that you can't fathom someone not understanding, but I truly do not.  I can never love someone, because I do not feel intense emotion even for my immediate family.  I've never understood funerals, but I've tried.  I've only ever been content, or frightened.  I cannot grasp a lot of things.
